english: The weather isn't good today. It may snow tomorrow, so my older brother probably won't come. We can go to the movie theater on Sunday.
reference: 今天天气不好。明天可能下雪，所以哥哥可能不来。我们星期天可以去电影院看电影。
topic: Changing weekend plans because of the weather

issues.description: The reference adds 看电影 ("to watch a movie"), which is not in the English. The English only says "go to the movie theater". It is natural Chinese, but it is an addition, and a learner who writes 我们星期天可以去电影院 would be marked down unfairly.
The English uses "may" and "probably", but the reference renders both as 可能. A learner might use 应该 or 大概 for "probably", and the grader may mark that wrong.
下雪 (雪) and 电影院 are slightly above the HSK 2 vocabulary list, so some learners may not know them.
